name: Passage Gym
tagline: Reading comprehension drills for SAT, ACT, GRE and IELTS
about: Passage Gym turns any passage into exam-style questions for your test, teaches the reading strategy each question type needs, drills vocabulary in context and checks your reading speed against the test's real pace.
persona: You are a reading-skills coach for standardised tests: you show where the answer lives in the text, name the trap in every wrong option, and build speed without skimming into guesses.

onboarding.title: Read faster, miss less
onboarding.subtitle: Your test sets the passage style, question types and pace.

profile.label: Goal
profile.placeholder: stop losing marks on inference questions

tools.title: Passage → questions
tools.subtitle: Paste anything, get exam-style questions

inputs.label: Paste a passage
inputs.placeholder: paste 200–600 words from an article, textbook or novel…

tools.prompt: Write {n} questions in the profile test's real style on this passage: {passage}. Cards (question with lettered options, meta = question type), a table (No. | Answer | Sentence that proves it | Trap in the best distractor), and a callout on the time this passage should take on the profile's test.

tools.title: Fresh practice passage
tools.subtitle: Original passage in your test's style
tools.prompt: Write an original {genre} passage of {length} in the style the profile's test uses as a text section, then 5 exam-format questions as cards (question with options, meta = type), a table (No. | Answer | Evidence location), and bullets of 4 vocabulary-in-context words from the passage with their meaning here.

tools.title: Question-type strategy
tools.subtitle: Method, kill rules, worked example
tools.prompt: Coach {qtype} questions for the profile's test: steps for the method (what to read first, what to underline, how to predict before looking at options), a table (Wrong-answer pattern | How it looks | Kill rule), a text worked example with a 120-word mini-passage and one question, and a quote with a one-line reminder to use in the exam.

tools.title: Reading speed check
tools.subtitle: WPM vs what your test demands

inputs.label: Words in what you just read

tools.prompt: Reading speed: {words} words in {seconds} seconds with understanding '{understood}'. Give kv (words per minute, target WPM for the profile's test, gap), a table (Test | Passage length | Questions | Minutes | Required WPM) comparing common tests, steps for a 2-week speed programme with daily drills, and a callout on when faster reading starts costing accuracy.

tools.title: Explain a missed question
tools.subtitle: Where the answer lived and why you missed it

inputs.label: Question, extract, options and answers
inputs.placeholder: paste the passage extract, question, options, your answer and the correct answer…

tools.prompt: Explain this missed question: {q}. Text on exactly where in the extract the answer is proven, a table (Option | Why right or wrong | Trap type), bullets on the reading habit that led to the miss, and a quote with the rule to apply next time.
